t_advice_summary_textbox.text: you are offered a red or yellow basket, red seems to collect more mushrooms and is offered by gnomes with red, blue, orange and pink hats.

vb_textbox.text: The advice i was given was to choose the gnomes with the red, blue, orange and pink hats,. These give a red basket which seems to give higher yields. I still got a few zeroes, but i also got several of 30+ as well. i would say that this seems to be a good principle with this game. just pay attention and don't forget to hit the space bar on the basket screen, or you lose on the potential mushrooms.
